allowed.reason: runRequest's declared return type admits RequestState's idle/loading members, but the function only ever resolves to success or error
getRequestLog() spreads the array but returns the same stored entry objects by reference, so a caller can mutate logged history
no test exercises the timeout path (the race against REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS / TimeoutError)
the "success" | "error" outcome literal is written out by hand twice (RequestLogEntry.outcome, logOutcome's parameter) instead of derived from RequestState["status"]
idleState has no callers anywhere in the fixture; runRequest never produces an idle or loading state
the setTimeout backing the timeout race is never cleared on the success path, so it can keep the process alive for up to REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS after resolving
